description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Maskwood Nexus, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 3.
